title: lumbar pillow
text: lumbar pillow. I purchased this for our golf cart.  The bench seat is not adjustable and is set further back than is comfortable for me.  So I decided to try this cushion and it works perfectly.  It fits perfectly over the top of the split top of the seat.  I am so happy with it!  I know it's not exactly what it is advertised in use, but it's great.  I would say it would be worth trying if you need lumbar support, or perhaps to be a bit closer to the steering wheel of your golf cart!  having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  And I hope this info was helpful to you.

product_metadata.title: FORTEM Lumbar Support Office Chair, Lumbar Support Pillow for Car, Office Chair Back Support, Lumbar Pillow for Desk Chair, Memory Foam Back Cushion, Washable Cover (Mesh, Grey)

Lightweight and Durable - Adjustable elastic straps, strong buckles, metal zipper make our lower back support pillow capable of everyday use. It can be used on a car seat, desk chair, wheelchair or any seat with a backrest. Being lightweight, it will be your favorite travel companion.

Ergonomic Design – Orthopedic design supports better posture by adjusting to your natural back curve. This helps alleviate pressure on the sciatica nerve to reduce mid/ lower back pain, muscle tension and helps with spine alignment, and overall stress relief.

Quality Materials - This desk chair back support pillow is made of pure memory foam encased with a removable, washable, breathable mesh cover. Our chair back support pillow cover is machine washer safe

One Year Warranty – Enjoy your lumbar support for car year-round driving your favorite car, truck, or gaming on your computer to heart's content. Your Fortem back support office chair pillow is covered for a full year!
